ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus Operation DreamJob — fake-job ISO/IMG mount and LNK-driven script execution from removable volume
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Lazarus/Labyrinth Chollima initial-access chain delivered via LinkedIn recruiter lures (Operation DreamJob / Contagious Interview): a victim mounts a job-description ISO/IMG/VHD and double-clicks an enclosed LNK that proxies execution to wscript/cscript/cmd/rundll32, with the script payload masquerading next to a decoy PDF/DOCX. The combination of explorer.exe spawning a scripting host whose command line points back into a CDROM/HarddiskVolume mount, paired with a decoy document write nearby, is documented Lazarus tradecraft across the 2022-2024 DreamJob waves reported by M
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Processes.process="*\\Device\\CdRom*" OR Processes.process="*\\Device\\HarddiskVolume*" OR Processes.process="*.iso\\*" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Device\\CdRom*" OR Processes.parent_process="*.lnk" OR Processes.process="*.lnk*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename host as dest | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("*Job*Description*.pdf","*JD*.pdf","*Salary*.pdf","*Coinbase*.pdf","*Amazon*Assessment*.docx","*Lockheed*.pdf","*Engineer*Position*.pdf","*Boeing*.pdf","*Crypto*Trader*.pdf") AND Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Device\\CdRom*","*\\Device\\HarddiskVolume*","*\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*") by dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 300;
let DecoyDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(job[_\-\s]*description|salary|position|engineer|developer|recruit|interview|assessment|coinbase|binance|lockheed|boeing|amazon|defi)\b.*\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?)$"
        or FolderPath has_any (@"\Device\CdRom", @"\Device\HarddiskVolume")
    | project DecoyTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DecoyFile = FileName, DecoyPath = FolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Device\CdRom", @"\Device\HarddiskVolume", ".lnk", ".iso", ".img", ".vhd")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Device\CdRom", @"\Device\HarddiskVolume", ".lnk")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=inner DecoyDrops on DeviceId
| where DecoyTime between (Timestamp - WindowSeconds * 1s .. Timestamp + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          DecoyFile, DecoyPath,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, DecoyTime),
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 300;
let DecoyDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)(job[_\-\s]*description|salary|position|engineer|developer|recruit|interview|assessment|coinbase|binance|lockheed|boeing|amazon|defi)\b.*\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?)$"
        or TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Device\CdRom", @"\Device\HarddiskVolume")
    | project DecoyTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DecoyFile = TargetFileName, DecoyPath = TargetFilePath, ActorUsername;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "explorer.exe"
| extend NewProcLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where NewProcLower has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"\Device\CdRom", @"\Device\HarddiskVolume", ".lnk", ".iso", ".img", ".vhd")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| join kind=inner (DecoyDrops) on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where DecoyTime between (TimeGenerated - WindowSeconds * 1s .. TimeGenerated + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, DecoyFile, DecoyPath,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, DecoyTime)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus DreamJob ISO/IMG Mount Spawning Script Host from Explorer
id: 5e1f8a2c-9b3d-4f6e-a4c7-1d8e7b3f9a21
status: experimental
description: Detects Lazarus (Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima) Operation DreamJob initial access where a job-themed ISO/IMG/VHD is mounted and a contained LNK is double-clicked from explorer.exe, proxying execution into wscript/cscript/cmd/rundll32/regsvr32/mshta/powershell with the command line referencing a CDROM or HarddiskVolume mount path.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
    - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/lazarus-uncovers-dream-job
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/18/diamond-sleet-supply-chain-compromise/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1566.001
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.t1059.003
    - attack.t1059.005
    - attack.g0032
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\rundll32.exe'
            - '\regsvr32.exe'
            - '\mshta.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
    selection_mount:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '\Device\CdRom'
            - '\Device\HarddiskVolume'
            - '.lnk'
            - '.iso'
            - '.img'
            - '.vhd'
    filter_machine_account:
        User|endswith: '$'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_mount and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate software installers shipped on ISO media (rare in enterprise; correlate with the decoy-document peer)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE) @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*\\Device\\CdRom* OR *\\Device\\HarddiskVolume* OR *.lnk* OR *.iso* OR *.img* OR *.vhd*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(wscript|cscript|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(\\\\Device\\\\CdRom|\\\\Device\\\\HarddiskVolume|\\.lnk|\\.iso|\\.img|\\.vhd)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)(job[_\\-\\s]*description|salary|position|engineer|developer|recruit|interview|assessment|coinbase|binance|lockheed|boeing|amazon|defi).*\\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?)$", field=TargetFileName)}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: DreamJob is Lazarus's signature initial-access vector since 2020 and was re-confirmed in CrowdStrike's LABYRINTH CHOLLIMA reporting, Mandiant's UNC4034/UNC2970 disclosures and Microsoft's Diamond Sleet writeups through 2024. The actor specifically uses ISO/IMG containers because they bypass Mark-of-the-Web on older Windows builds, and they always pair the LNK execution with a decoy job-description

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 3CX-style DLL side-loading with steganographic GitHub icon C2 retrieval (TAXHAUL / SUDDENICON)
ucs.description: Hunts the trojanized-signed-binary side-loading chain Lazarus (ZINC / Diamond Sleet) used in the 3CXDesktopApp supply-chain compromise (CVE-2023-29059, Mandiant UNC4736) and its 2024 variants against defense and crypto targets: a legitimately-signed third-party application loads an attacker-supplied DLL from its install folder (e.g. ffmpeg.dll, d3dcompiler_47.dll, msvcr100.dll) which then beacons to a GitHub-hosted repository to download .ico files containing AES-encrypted C2 URLs hidden after a steganographic marker. The combination of an Image-Load from a non-system path under Program Files
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("ffmpeg.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","msvcr100.dll","libcef.dll","VERSION.dll","DSROLE.dll","colorui.dll","WindowsCodecs.dll") AND NOT (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Windows\\System32\\*","*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*","*\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*")) AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Program Files*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*") by host Filesystem.process_guid Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename host as dest process_guid as loader_guid | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","github.com") OR All_Traffic.url="*.ico*") AND NOT All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","git.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","code.exe") by dest All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.url All_Traffic.dest_host | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let SideloadDlls = dynamic(["ffmpeg.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","msvcr100.dll","libcef.dll","version.dll","dsrole.dll","colorui.dll","windowscodecs.dll"]);
let SuspiciousLoads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where tolower(FileName) in (SideloadDlls)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
    | where FolderPath !has @"\WinSxS\"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Program Files", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !in~ ("Microsoft Corporation","Microsoft")
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              LoaderImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              LoaderName  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              LoaderPid   = InitiatingProcessId,
              LoaderSigner= InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              SideloadDll = FileName, SideloadPath = FolderPath, SideloadSHA256 = SHA256;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com")
   or (RemoteUrl has "github.com" and RemoteUrl has ".ico")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","git.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","code.exe","GitHubDesktop.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !in~ ("Microsoft Corporation","Microsoft","GitHub, Inc.","Google LLC","Mozilla Corporation")
| join kind=inner SuspiciousLoads on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId,
                                     $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.LoaderPid
| where Timestamp between (LoadTime .. LoadTime + WindowMinutes)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          LoaderName, LoaderImage, LoaderSigner,
          SideloadDll, SideloadPath, SideloadSHA256,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, LoadTime)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:7 @ImageLoaded:(*\\ffmpeg.dll OR *\\FFmpeg.dll OR *\\d3dcompiler_47.dll OR *\\D3DCompiler_47.dll OR *\\msvcr100.dll OR *\\MSVCR100.dll OR *\\libcef.dll OR *\\LIBCEF.DLL OR *\\version.dll OR *\\VERSION.dll OR *\\colorui.dll OR *\\ColorUI.dll OR *\\windowscodecs.dll OR *\\WindowsCodecs.dll) -@ImageLoaded:(*\\System32\\* OR *\\SysWOW64\\* OR *\\WinSxS\\*)) OR (@EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(raw.githubusercontent.com OR objects.githubusercontent.com OR codeload.github.com) -@Image:(*\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\git.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\GitHubDesktop.exe OR *\\Code.exe)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ClassifiedModuleLoad OR #event_simpleName=ImageHash)
| TargetFileName=/\\(ffmpeg|d3dcompiler_47|msvcr100|libcef|version|dsrole|colorui|windowscodecs)\.dll$/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\(System32|SysWOW64|WinSxS)\\/i
| regex("\\\\(Program Files|AppData|ProgramData)\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(raw\.githubusercontent\.com|objects\.githubusercontent\.com|codeload\.github\.com)$/i | NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|git|curl|wget|code|GitHubDesktop)\.exe$/i}, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, DomainName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The 3CX TAXHAUL/SUDDENICON chain (Mandiant UNC4736, attributed by Microsoft to Diamond Sleet and by CrowdStrike to LABYRINTH CHOLLIMA — both Lazarus subclusters) is one of the most-documented Lazarus campaigns of the last three years and the same side-loading-plus-GitHub-stego pattern was reused in 2024 against TradingTechnologies victims and the DPRK 'Pyongyang's spies in your IDE' developer-targ
